notes.title: Anagraphs Launch | Developer Demo and Q&A
notes.content:
Anagraphs - the anagram game with a fun new twist - arrives on Steam 6/21! To celebrate, we'll be playing through and answering any of your questions about our new linguistic brain teaser.

Named one of the "[url=https://www.droidgamers.com/2021/04/28/the-17-best-word-games-on-android/]17 Best Word Games[/url]" by DroidGamer.com, Anagraphs is an educational word puzzle designed the educational non-profit Cinq-Mars Media to build linguistic and spatial skills. An anagraph is an extension of an anagram in which letters can be rotated. In a typical anagram, the letters of a word are rearranged to make another, such as [i]raw[/i] and [i]war[/i]. Using the specially designed Anagraph game font, the r and m characters can be rotated to shift from [i]raw[/i] to [i]ram[/i], [i]jam[/i], and [i]jaw[/i]. The game begins with simple puzzles but quickly increases in difficulty, requiring you to optimize efficiency in order to progress, culminating in “Open Play” mode, for the ultimate language-puzzle meditative flow.
